description: Median and quartile posted salary (annual USD, from roles that state a range) by seniority level, optionally filtered by country, remote, discipline or keywords. Only roles with a posted USD range count (a minority of listings; roles_with_salary gives the number), so treat small samples with caution; the sample size is returned per level.

location.description: City/state/country text to match in the posted location, e.g. "London", "New York", "Germany". Use "remote" for remote roles.

min_salary_usd.description: Only roles whose posted annual USD salary range reaches at least this figure. Roles that post no USD range never match, and most roles post none.

posted_within_days.description: Only roles posted in the last N days (1–60).

query.description: Keywords matched against title, company, location and description, e.g. "senior product designer fintech". All words must match.

remote.description: true = only fully-remote roles; false = exclude remote roles.

remote_from.description: Remote roles open to candidates in this region (implies remote). Roles open "Anywhere" match every region; roles that only say "Remote" with no region are not matched. Same rules as the Remote-from filter on jobs.uxjobs.io.

role_family.description: Design discipline derived from the title.

workplace.description: Workplace arrangement when the employer stated one.

name: salary_snapshot
title: Posted salary ranges by seniority
